summary: Automation graphs: built-in nodes notify (users, groups, roles and trigger-event participants, channels, level) and send_to_contact (phone or email of a record) in pkg/automation/builtin/notify, both effects that queue the notice with notifications.AudienceSender.SendTx in the step transaction under the automations.notify.v1 definition, registered by the automations module together with the nodes; the engine gains effect nodes that pick an outcome (OutcomeEffectNode), dry-run previews (EffectPreviewer, DryRunOptions.Preview), node graph rules (GraphChecker), StepContext.NodeID/Trigger/StepKey; notifications.AudienceReceipt.Skipped; the catalog view lists the participants of each event and the editor shows the participants field only where the trigger events offer them.
